name: Atria
summary: Competitor ad research and AI creative generation for Meta and TikTok in one platform.
best_for: performance marketers and creative teams that want competitor ad research and AI ad-creative generation for Meta and TikTok in one platform
skip_if: you don't run paid social at volume, or you only need ad inspiration (a cheaper ad-library tool) or only design (a general creative tool)
honest_knock: Two honest notes. It's credit-metered — AI credits and brand-tracking slots cap what you can generate and monitor, so a heavy user burns through Core's allowance and steps up to Plus. And it's specialized for Meta/TikTok ad creative research and generation, so it's a performance-marketing tool, not a general design suite. Its edge is competitor ad intelligence plus creative generation in one place; if you only need one of those, a cheaper single-purpose tool may fit.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a month, billed annually (a stated $360/yr saving), 5 seats
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-08-17 and 2026-10-07 on their own pricing page, annual billing, which Atria advertises as 20% off) Core is $129/mo, a stated $360 saving a year. That covers 5 seats, 4,000 AI credits a month, 50 brands followed without AI insights, 5 connected ad accounts, $500K of ad spend analysed a month, 5GB of asset storage and 3 brand profiles. Plus $479/mo (a stated $1,440 saving): 8 seats, 10,000 credits, 100 brands with AI insights, 10 ad accounts, $1M of ad spend, 1TB storage, 8 brand profiles. Business $959/mo (a stated $2,880 saving): 15 seats, 25,000 credits, 200 brands with AI insights, unlimited ad accounts and ad spend. Enterprise is custom. Extra seats are $20 each a month on every tier. Note the step from Core to Plus is far steeper than the tier names suggest — it is roughly 3.7x the price for 2.5x the credits. Billed monthly, read 7 October 2026: Core $159, Plus $599, Business $1,199. Against those monthly rates annual billing saves 18.9% on Core ($360 a year) and 20.0% on Plus and Business, so the 'Save 20%' label is slightly generous on Core. Core also includes 600 MCP calls and 1,200 REST API calls a month, and each call over the cap costs 1 AI credit; on Plus and above both are unlimited.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 23 October 2026 on a new Free account, without connecting an ad account, without the browser extension and without a card: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We set up a made-up brand and product (a teal mug, with our own product image and a fixed headline), generated one batch of image ads and downloaded one.
findings: Atria shows the cost before you generate: hovering over the button said 'Use 144 credits to generate 4 variants', and the number of variants cannot go below 4 per reference. After about half a minute the balance went from 1,250 to 1,106, exactly 144.
All four images used our headline word for word ('Your morning, one teal mug.') and showed a teal mug on a white or light background, in the shape of our own product image.
'Download image' gave a 1168x1168 PNG (1.0 MB) straight away. The detail view also offers 'Copy link', 4:5 and 9:16 versions, and edits (Adjust, Text, Vary, Magic Layer).
The new Free account showed 1,250 credits, while Atria's homepage says '1,000 free credits included'.

A brand can be filled in automatically from a website or by hand in five steps (profile, guidelines, audience, competitors, ad accounts); everything except the profile could be skipped. For competitors, the assistant suggested six brands that had nothing to do with a mug brand. The multi-select lists sometimes picked an extra value when we clicked outside the field.
We found no export for the brand profile, the product profile or the prompts; images come out one PNG at a time.
